method.title: Methodology
method.conceptBody: Susceptibility is precomputed offline from terrain and never changes with the weather; the predictors used are listed in this file’s metadata and shown per cell in the inspector. Triggering is computed live in this browser from rainfall. The map shows the product of the two.
method.simulatedBody: The sensor node panel shows generated values, not readings from a deployed device. Field hardware is in development.
method.noMetadata: This grid file carries no metadata block, so generation details are unavailable. Regenerate it with the offline pipeline to embed them.
method.aucNote: The random split scores higher because neighbouring cells are not independent — a cell’s neighbours leak into the test fold. The spatial-block figure holds whole 0.5° blocks out, and is the honest one.

search.placeholder: Search a village, town or district…
search.outsideRegion: Outside monitored region. PAHARA currently covers the eight Northeastern states.
search.unmonitored: No modelled slope near this place. Cells below 3° are excluded, so flat valley floor is not scored.
search.unmonitoredNear: No modelled slope near this place — the closest is {{km}} km away. Cells below 3° are excluded, so flat valley floor is not scored.
search.nearestCell: Nearest monitored cell, {{km}} km away. This rating describes that cell, not the settlement itself.
search.higherRisk: Nearest higher-risk zone: {{km}} km {{dir}} ({{cls}}). Your route out may be worse than your location.

plain.title: Is a landslide likely near me?
plain.searchHint: Type a place name in the Northeast
plain.emptyBody: PAHARA tells you whether a landslide is likely near a place today, using the shape of the land and the rain that has fallen on it.
plain.adviceNote: General guidance, not an official evacuation order. Always follow your district administration and the NDMA.
plain.higherNear: Higher risk {{km}} km {{dir}} of here. Your house may be fine while your road out is not.
plain.distantCell: The nearest modelled hillside is {{km}} km away, so this is the closest reading, not a reading of this exact spot.
plain.nodataTitle: No slope data for this place
plain.nodataBody: PAHARA has no modelled hillside near {{name}}. That is not the same as safe — the model simply has nothing to say here. Many valley-floor towns are in this position.
plain.outsideBody: PAHARA currently covers the eight Northeastern states of India.
plain.numbersNote: Risk is how steep and slide-prone the land is, multiplied by how wet it is. Either one alone is not a danger.
plain.mapHint: Tap the map to check anywhere else.

Safe.headline: Safe today
Safe.summary: No landslide is expected near this place right now.
Safe.do2: Check again if heavy rain starts.
Safe.do3: Know which way you would leave, just in case.

Watch.headline: Stay alert
Watch.summary: Conditions here could turn. Worth keeping an eye on.
Watch.do1: Watch the rain over the next day.
Watch.do2: Keep your phone charged and this page saved.
Watch.do3: Agree with your family where you would go.

Warning.headline: Danger — be ready to move
Warning.summary: A landslide is possible near this place. Prepare to leave.
Warning.do1: Pack papers, medicines and a torch now.
Warning.do2: Stay off steep slopes and roads cut into hillsides.
Warning.do3: Tell your neighbours, especially anyone who cannot walk far.

Evacuate.headline: Move to safety now
Evacuate.summary: A landslide is likely near this place. Do not wait.
Evacuate.do1: Leave for flat, open ground away from slopes.
Evacuate.do2: Do not use roads cut into hillsides.
Evacuate.do3: Call your village head or the district control room.

reason.steepWet: This is a steep, slide-prone hillside, and it has been raining hard.
reason.steepDry: The hillside here can slide, but little rain has fallen. Rain is what starts a slide.
reason.gentleWet: It has been raining hard, but the ground here is not steep enough to slide easily.
reason.gentleDry: The ground here is not steep, and little rain has fallen.

welcome.title: Welcome to PAHARA
welcome.subtitle: Landslide warning for Northeast India
welcome.s1Body: Type a place name and see whether a landslide is likely near it today.
welcome.s2Body: A slope that can fail, and rain heavy enough to start it. One without the other is not a danger — PAHARA checks both.
welcome.s3Body: Green is safe, yellow means stay alert, orange means get ready, red means move now.
welcome.reopen: You can see this again from the help icon.
